opening.argument: The video presents a cashback referral program with identifiable steps and controls. Viewers are told to copy a referral link and invite friends; the CashKaro screen shows that link alongside sharing options and says users can earn 10% cashback when a friend shops. A separate earnings screen shows cashback marked pending and buttons for requesting payment. These details describe referral-related rewards tied to cashback tracking, rather than a request for upfront payment, credentials, or investment funds. The earning claims may need substantiation, and the payout terms are inconsistent. But the available evidence establishes no deception, impersonation, victim loss, or misuse of external links.
